params.body:
Small follow-up to #19. `candidate` reads as "coming soon", and that would be a promise nobody intends to keep: the profiler stays six axes by design, because seven axes in a figure that lives off three dimensions is no longer a figure. Verifiability belongs to the framework, not to the picture.

So the label says `framework only: the profiler visualises six axes`, in both languages, and the spec carries `status: framework-only` instead of `candidate`. A state, not a backlog.

Same reason the worklist chips stopped naming playbooks that do not exist this morning: a label that promises something nobody will build is the cheapest kind of untruth.
params.title: Alleen framework, en niet "nog niet"
